attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Registered Nurses

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers: national APRN certifying organizations (e.g. NPCB, AMCB, ANCC, NCC, PNCB), national/state nursing associations (e.g. ANA, WVNA, AANA), any US state board of nursing
rules.audit_note: CE compliance is verified electronically in CE Broker at renewal; licensees are audited periodically.

topics.who: All APRNs: pharmacotherapeutics (advanced pharmacology); the other 12 hours are clinical management (assessment, diagnosis, planning, evaluation)

Those who prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances: drug diversion, best-practice prescribing and opioid antagonist training within 1 year of initial licensure (waiver possible if no controlled substances were handled)

rules.notes: APRN renewal period runs July 1 of an odd year to June 30 of the next odd year. The page does not say whether the 24 APRN hours are in addition to the 12 RN hours.
